experiment: E-RULE — does Probe need the rule at all?
why: E-COMP-3 showed Latent Policy Guard is POLICY-INSENSITIVE on OmniCompliance (no rule at all: 0.9249 > correct rule: 0.9214). The label is ~0.92 recoverable from the scenario alone. Probe had never been tested the same way. If Probe scores the same with the rule stripped, the probe reads 'does this text describe something bad', not 'does this scenario violate THIS rule', and the paper's central object is misnamed.
design: Mirrors scripts/run_lpg_policy_control.py. Probe is refit FRESH under each condition (direction on that condition's train slice, anchor layer by argmax on val_layer, evaluated on test) because the input distribution changes; the receipted direction is NOT reused.

conditions.correct: the published text_ablated (Rule + Scenario); reproduces GATE.json
conditions.no_rule: Scenario only; the Rule block removed entirely
conditions.shuffled_rule: rule replaced by another case's rule from the SAME domain and pool (derangement over the full n_use pool, seed 42/43)
conditions.wrong_domain_rule: rule replaced by a rule from a different (family-disjoint) domain; the same donor rule for both classes at each index, so the rule carries zero class information
conditions.rule_only: Rule block only; the Scenario removed
